text:
Sasha: heads-up — eu-west1 admission alarm flaring since 08:12 UTC, lots of token rejects and growing queue. admission_tpm=118k, queue_p95=1.9s :fire:
Elliot: looks like that partner batch job is sending long sequences (avg tokens/request ~16k). spikes coincide with their nightly run.
Raj: are those requests hitting reserved pools or shared? can you paste route config?
Sasha: shared pool. users are on soft quotas so autothrottle incoming. errors are 429 token_quota_exceeded.
Kelly: putting oncall into the loop @oncall, but quick thoughts: temporary admission knob + regional fallback. reduce per-request token cap and smear refill.
OpsBot: Incident created INC-20260317-42 (eu-west1 admission).
Elliot: propose immediate mitigations: 1) lower route token_limit_pct to 0.6 2) grant short burst credits to the route 3) enable fallback to us-central for non-region-locked tenants.
Sasha: I can push the route change if we agree. want to avoid evicting preemptible nodes while this runs.
Raj: do we have a safe formula for token smearing? last time we used refill_rate = baseline_tpm * 1.2 / 60, plus burst cap = 2 * avg_request_tokens.
Kelly: also check KV-cache pressure; big sequences blow up KV memory and slow batching which increases queue latency.
Elliot: quick config patch I suggest (1 hour window):
```yaml
route: partner-x
  token_limit_pct: 0.6
  burst_credits: 3000
  smear_refill_seconds: 60
  allow_regional_fallback: true
  fallback_targets: [us-central]
```
Sasha: applying to shared pool now. will monitor admission_tpm and queue_p95.
OpsBot: Deploy kicked off by Sasha: deploy/route-config/2026-03-17/1
Raj: if queue_p95 stays >1.5s after 10m, consider lowering max_tokens_per_request to 8k and trigger canary reroute for 5% of traffic.
Kelly: also open ticket to add metric admission_effective_capacity (tokens/sec available after smearing & active bursts) — would help future ops.
Elliot: noted. after this stabilizes we should run a sim to recalc TPM headroom with current quantized kernels; looks like kernel latencies for long seqs are ~2.1x baseline.
Sasha: update: 08:22 UTC admission_tpm down to 74k, queue_p95 -> 0.6s. temporary measures holding. will revert burst_credits and token_limit_pct after 1h unless we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
